:::{#exr-rank-practice}
#### Finding the rank of a $3 \times 3$ matrix

The [rank](#def-rank) of a data [matrix](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix) counts how many of its [columns](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-column) carry new information.
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \sbmat{1 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 \\ 2 & 1 & 3}.
$$

Find $\rankf{\matr{A}}$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Add the first two [columns of $\matr{A}$](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-column) and compare them with the third.
Then check whether the first two are [linearly independent](#def-linearly-independent).

:::
